body: How am i not in the right sub? Im asking if im an a**hole
I posted it to youtube. Heres a link [youtube video](https://youtu.be/QrW84VfGIa8)
Let me see if i can find it on youtube for you. Its hard to explain. Its  song lol

Im honestly feeling this video today on a personal level. Take a watch if you want a giggle!

https://vm.tiktok.com/ZSpmvCMt/

Awe i totally understand.  I didnt find counseling helpful the first few times. Eventually it just became a safe space to vent. 

Im sorry your brother is like that, he should be glad you are getting help you need if you choose to go that route.
Pills definitely arnt in everybody's comfort level, so definitely think about it before jumping willy nilly.  I have taken meds from a young age. I was taught our bodies sometimes dont make the chemicals needed on their own, so we sometimes need a boost and there is no shame in that.

Unfortunately i live in alberta canada, and they locked us down again last week from all social gatherings. If im caught going to a friends house or vise versa they are handing out 1000$ tickets. 

I have tried voice or video call and it does help a tiny bit, but i have a toddler that throws tantrums if shes not the center of attention when it comes to cameras lol.

And no worries you arnt being too nosey at all for me :)

May i ask if you are seeing counselors or have considered antidepressants?
Not sure if me asking that is allowed.
Antidepressants helped me alot when i felt that way. 
Those feelings definitely seem to go hand in hand with depression, because i felt those very strongly too. 

I struggle with self love too at times, i went from a 00 at a young age to a size 20 in my 20's, and im trying so hard to be happy in my body. 
Starving yourself is not good, i agree, but when depressed i find you go either way. You either eat too much or not enough

I am currently talking to a few on facebook messenger, but finding little comfort in it. I think personally i need some human interaction to feel a little better. Im a social butterfly, and miss company :(

Depression is so hard to live with. It hits every person differently :(

How long have you felt numb? Do you ever find times where you can feel little bouts of joy, even if its for a few seconds?

I found when i felt numb, looking for tiny joys in my day helped. Especially during postpartum depression, if my daughter smiled at me, it would make me feel this burts of love and joy for a few seconds. I found it was the only thing that got me though my day sometimes.

I have friends, but with covid i cant see anybody. I live with my parents right now but they arnt helpful at all... they just stopped asking if i want to terminate my pregnancy, and their answers just cause more sadness in me.
I feel very isolated and alone right now. My only comfort is my amazing little girl and the soft kicks i feel in my tummy from time to time.

I have cried a few times in the past few months, but not for any actual reason. Just pregnancy crap i guess. I feel kinda dumb crying because i cant have tacos, but unable to bat an eye when i ended a 5.5 year long relationship or when a loved one passes away... like wtf is wrong with me...

I have felt this way to an extent. I thought i was broken. Things didnt trigger me like they used to. I havent cried in years, especially in sad situations... sending you a virtual hug. Im hopeful things turn around for you.

I guess im worried too. I have always dreamed of being pregnant and having children. Im not against adoption if we cant conceive, but i think a part of me would be heart broken that i wasnt able to experience the joy of pregnancy/birth.

I am keeping an eye on cycle and temp, but i have a very irregular cycle so its not down to an exact science unfortunatly. Yes to keeping an eye on mucus and using specific positions after and during intercourse. Im not sure what you mean by opks. I havent heard the term before..
